Chocolate Strawberry Banana Bread 🍓🍌✨ Ingredients: 	•	3 overripe bananas, mashed (330 g) 	•	4 tbsp unsalted butter, melted (56 g) 	•	¼ cup Greek yogurt or sour cream (60 g) 	•	½ cup brown sugar, packed (100 g) 	•	¼ cup granulated sugar (50 g) 	•	1 large egg (≈50 g) 	•	1 tsp vanilla extract (5 g) 	•	1¼ cups all-purpose flour (150 g) 	•	⅓ cup cocoa powder (≈30 g) 	•	1 tsp baking soda (5 g) 	•	1 tsp cinnamon (≈2.5 g) 	•	Dash of salt (≈0.5 g) 	•	½ cup chocolate chips, plus more for topping (85 g) 	•	⅓ cup chopped strawberries (≈50 g), plus extra for topping @Nestle Toll House  Instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Grease or line a loaf pan with parchment paper.In a medium bowl, mash the bananas until smooth. Add the melted butter and Greek yogurt (or sour cream) and mix until combined. Stir in the egg and vanilla extract. Add the brown sugar and granulated sugar; mix well until smooth. Gently fold in the flour, cocoa powder, baking soda, cinnamon, and salt until just combined — do not overmix. Fold in the chocolate chips and chopped strawberries. Pour the batter into the prepared loaf pan. Sprinkle extra chocolate chips and chopped strawberries on top. Bake for 35–40 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out mostly clean (a few moist crumbs are okay). Let cool in the pan for 10–15 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely. #bananabread #Recipe #chocolatestrawberries #valentine #bakingrecipe

Strawberry Nutella Brownies 🍓🤎 Perfect brownies for summer!  (recipe makes an 8x8 pan) Ingredients:  10 tbsp (140g) unsalted butter, melted 1 cup (200g) granulated sugar ¼ cup (50g) brown sugar, packed  2 eggs, room temp 1 tsp vanilla extract ½ cup + 2 tbsp (56g) unsweetened cocoa powder ½ tsp salt 1 tbsp (13g) vegetable oil ½ cup (63g) all purpose flour, spooned & leveled or weighed (don’t pack it in) ¾ cup chocolate chips 190g (~⅔ cup) Nutella  Topping: Strawberry slices, patted dry (as many as you want/enough to cover the top) Nutella (to spread over the top & drizzle)  Instructions: Line an 8x8 pan with parchment paper. Spread the nutella onto the parchment into a thin, even square the size of the pan. Freeze for at least 30 minutes or until frozen solid. Preheat oven to 325°F and line/grease an 8x8 pan with parchment. In a large bowl, whisk melted butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until smooth. Add eggs and vanilla, then whisk vigorously for 1-2 minutes. Stir in cocoa powder and salt until fully combined. Mix in oil, then gently fold in the flour until just combined (don’t over mix). Fold in chocolate chips. Spread half the batter into the greased pan. Place the frozen nutella sheet on top of it. Then, spread the remaining batter over it to cover the nutella layer completely. Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until a toothpick near the center comes out with no wet batter. It should just come out with a little nutella & slightly moist crumbs. Let the brownies cool completely. Spread a thin layer of nutella over the cooled brownies, add strawberry slices (patted dry) all over the top, and drizzle with more nutella.  Best enjoyed fresh!  #bakingrecipe #brownies #chocolatestrawberries #nutella #recipe

If there is one meal that belongs on your fall dinner table, it’s a cozy pot roast. Slow cooked until tender, served over creamy mashed potatoes and finished with a rich broth. It’s the ultimate comfort meal for fall 🍂 Full recipe down below, you can also find it in the link in my bio 🤎  Beef pot roast Ingredients: 	⁃	2-3 lb chuck roast 	⁃	1 medium white onion, sliced 	⁃	3 celery stalks, diced 	⁃	3 large carrots, sliced  	⁃	Bite size potatoes 	⁃	5 garlic cloves, minced 	⁃	Rosemary  	⁃	Thyme 	⁃	2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce 	⁃	3 tbsp tomato paste 	⁃	2 Au jus gravy packets 	⁃	6 cups beef bone broth 	⁃	3 tbsp unsalted butter 	⁃	2 tbsp onion powder 	⁃	2 tbsp garlic powder 	⁃	Salt to taste Instructions: Wash and prep all of your vegetables. Peel and dice the carrots, slice the onion, mince the garlic, and dice the celery. Season the chuck roast to your liking. I used onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Make sure to season all sides of the roast. Add oil to a Dutch oven and sear the roast on all sides for 3–4 minutes per side. Remove the roast from the pot and set aside. Add the celery and onion to the pot and cook over medium heat until the onion has caramelized. Add the minced garlic last to prevent it from burning. Add the tomato paste, Worcestershire sauce, and gravy packets. Add ½ cup of beef broth to deglaze the pot, then pour in the remaining broth. Add the seasonings and taste to make sure everything is seasoned to your liking. Add the roast back to the pot, along with the carrots, potatoes, butter, and a bunch of rosemary and thyme tied together with butcher’s twine. Cover and place in a 350°F oven for 3 hours. About 30 minutes before the roast is finished, prepare the mashed potatoes. To assemble, add a bed of mashed potatoes to a plate, then top with the roast, potatoes, and carrots. Finish with some of the broth and fresh or dried parsley. Enjoy! 🤎 #fall #fallrecipes #potroast #cozyvibes #fallvibes

FLATBREAD WITH BUTTER CHICKEN #food #recipe #chicken #butterchicken #flatbread CHICKEN MIXTURE 25 g unsalted butter 20 ml sunflower oil 600 g chicken thighs, cut into cubes 5 g garam masala (1⅔ tsp) 2 g ground coriander (⅔ tsp) 2 g ground cumin (⅔ tsp) 3 g garlic powder (1 tsp) 4 g onion powder (1⅓ tsp) 2 g cayenne pepper (⅔ tsp) 30 g tomato paste 50 ml water 100 ml heavy cream 15 g honey 1 chicken stock cube 100 g grated cheese (Gouda) DOUGH 350 g all-purpose flour 50 g herb cream cheese 4 g salt (⅔ tsp) 6 g baking powder 170 ml water EXTRA cheese slices Heat the butter and sunflower oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the chicken thighs, garam masala, ground coriander, ground cumin, garlic powder, onion powder, and cayenne pepper. Fry for 5–6 minutes. Add the tomato paste, water, cream, and honey. Mix well and let simmer for 5–7 minutes until the sauce has slightly thickened. Crumble the chicken stock cube over the pan. Add the grated cheese and stir until creamy. Remove from the heat and let the chicken mixture cool completely. Place the flour, baking powder, herb cream cheese, salt, and water in a large bowl. Knead for 10–12 minutes until smooth. Cover and let the dough rest for 10 minutes. Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces of about 70 g each and shape into balls. Roll out a dough ball into a circle. Place a slice of cheese on one half and spread about 90 g of the chicken mixture on top. Lightly moisten the edges, fold the dough closed, and press the edges firmly to seal. Place the filled dough on a sheet of parchment paper. Heat a heavy-bottomed frying pan with a little oil. Cook the breads over medium-high heat until golden brown and cooked through on both sides. Tips Don’t cut the chicken too small. Cubes of about 2 cm give a better bite. Let the mixture thicken well. The sauce should be creamy and firm, not runny like a curry. Let it cool completely. A warm filling makes the dough soft and hard to seal. Letting the dough rest is important. Those 10 minutes make it more elastic and easier to roll out. Use any cheese you like. You can also bake these breads in the oven. Preheat the oven to 200°C (390°F) and bake for 15–20 minutes (brush with oil or butter). Add salt to taste. Preparation Time Chicken mixture preparation & cooling: 20 minutes Dough preparation & resting: 25 minutes Cooking: 10–15 minutes

Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice. Enjoy! 🤍

Creamy Garlic Parmesan Penne with Steak, Broccoli & Bell Peppers 🥩🧄🥦🫑🧀🍝 Tender penne pasta tossed with juicy seared steak, crisp-tender broccoli, and sweet bell peppers in a rich garlic Parmesan cream sauce. This skillet dinner is bold, comforting, and loaded with steakhouse flavor—ready in just 30 minutes! 🥩🧄🧀🍝🔥 📝 Ingredients: 12 oz penne pasta 1.25 lb sirloin or ribeye steak, cut into bite-size pieces Salt & black pepper, to taste 1 tsp garlic powder 2 tbsp olive oil 3 tbsp unsalted butter 4 cloves garlic, minced 1 cup heavy cream ½ cup beef or chicken broth 1 cup grated Parmesan cheese 1 tsp Italian seasoning 1 cup broccoli florets, blanched 1 red bell pepper, sliced 1 green bell pepper, sliced 2 tbsp fresh parsley, chopped 🔥 Instructions: 1. Cook the Penne: Boil penne in salted water until al dente. Drain and set aside. 2. Sear the Steak: Season steak with salt, pepper, and garlic powder. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Sear steak 1–2 minutes per side until browned. Remove and set aside. 3. Sauté the Veggies: In the same skillet, add butter and garlic. Sauté for 1–2 minutes until fragrant. Add broccoli and bell peppers; cook 3–4 minutes until crisp-tender. 4. Make the Garlic Parmesan Sauce: Stir in heavy cream, broth, and Parmesan. Simmer 2–3 minutes until thick and creamy. Add Italian seasoning. 5. Combine Everything: Return steak and penne to the skillet. Toss until fully coated in the creamy sauce. 6. Finish & Serve: Garnish with parsley and extra Parmesan if desired. Serve hot. ⏱ Prep Time: 10 minutes 🔥 Cook Time: 20 minutes ⏲️ Total Time: 30 minutes 🍽 Servings: 4 🥩🧄 Creamy, garlicky, and loaded with steakhouse flavor—this penne skillet with steak, broccoli, and peppers is the ultimate weeknight indulgence! 🥦🫑🧀🔥

School Nights in the Slow Cooker  Part 4 | Crockpot Broccoli Cheddar Chicken Orzo  This is one of those easy dinners that feels like comfort food but is simple enough for a busy school night! Ingredients 1–1½ lbs chicken breast ½ sweet onion, diced ½ cup shredded carrots Chicka Licka Bam Bam Chicken Rub, to taste @Fire & Smoke Society  ½ tsp garlic powder ½ tsp onion powder 2 tsp chicken bouillon powder ½ tsp paprika ¼ tsp black pepper 1½ cups chicken broth 2 cups broccoli 1 cup orzo 1 (8 oz) block cheddar cheese, freshly shredded plus more for topping  ½ cup heavy cream Salt, to taste at the end Directions 1. Add the chicken, diced onion, shredded carrots, chicken rub, garlic powder, onion powder, chicken bouillon powder, paprika, black pepper, and chicken broth to your slow cooker. 2. Cover and cook on LOW for 4–5 hours or HIGH for 2–3 hours, until the chicken is cooked through and tender. 3. Remove the chicken, shred or chop it, and return it to the slow cooker. 4. Stir in the orzo, broccoli, heavy cream, and shredded cheddar. Cover and cook on HIGH for about 30 minutes, stirring once or twice, until the orzo is tender. Raspberry cheesecake donuts ✨ Ingredients  Donuts - 435g bread flour (3 cups + 2 tbsp) - 68g granulated sugar (1/3 cup) - 185g whole milk (3/4 cup) - 60g unsalted butter, softened (4 tbsp) - 7g active dry yeast (2 1/4 tsp) - 2 large eggs - 1 tsp vanilla extract  - 1/2 tsp salt - Canola oil for frying Raspberry jam - 300g raspberries (about 2 cups) - 225g granulated sugar (1 cup + 2 tbsp) - Juice of 1/2 lemon - Cornstarch slurry Cheesecake filling - 5 oz cream cheese, softened  - 250g powdered sugar (2 cups) - 57g unsalted butter, softened (4 tbsp) - 45g heavy cream (3 tbsp) - 2 tsp vanilla extract - 1 dolop of raspberry jam - 1/4 tsp salt  Raspberry sugar  - 15g freeze dried raspberries, blended (about 1 cup) - 120g granulated sugar (1/2 cup) Instructions  - In a large bowl, bloom the yeast with 1 tbsp honey in the warm milk for 5–10 minutes, or until foamy - Add eggs, sugar, vanilla extract and mix until well combined. - Add the flour and salt, then mix until a shaggy consistency  - Transfer the dough to a lightly floured surface (or use a stand mixer) and knead for 10–20 minutes, adding 1 tbsp of softened butter at a time until fully incorporated. Continue kneading until the dough is smooth, elastic, and passes the windowpane test. - Transfer dough to a lightly greased bowl, cover, and let rise 1–1½ hours, or until doubled in size. - While the dough rises, make the raspberry jam by cooking the raspberries, sugar, and lemon juice until thick. Add a cornstarch slurry if needed. Let cool. - Beat together the cream cheese, butter, powdered sugar, heavy cream, vanilla, salt, and a dollop of raspberry jam until fluffy. Refrigerate both fillings while the dough rises, then let them sit at room temperature before filling. - Punch down dough and separate into 12 balls (weighing 65g each) - Place the dough balls on a parchment-lined baking tray, leaving space between each. - Cover loosely and let rise for 30–40 minutes, or until puffy. When gently poked, the dough should slowly spring back, leaving a slight indentation. - In a large skillet heat oil to 315–335°F (aim for 330°F) - Fry the donuts, flipping every 30–45 seconds, until evenly golden brown and cooked through (about 2–3 minutes total). - Transfer the donuts to a wire rack to drain for 1–2 minutes. - Mix the freeze-dried raspberry powder with the sugar, then coat the warm donuts. - Poke a hole in each donut, then pipe in the raspberry jam followed by the cheesecake filling. • • • #baking #recipes #recipeideas #bakingideas #donuts

Loaded Italian Deli Meat Stromboli Ingredients 1. Pizza Dough – 1 lb 2. Pepperoni – 6 oz, thinly sliced 3. Deli Ham – 6 oz, thinly sliced 4. Salami – 6 oz, thinly sliced 5. Provolone Cheese – 6 oz, sliced 6. Mozzarella Cheese – 2 cups, shredded 7. Parmesan Cheese – 1/2 cup, finely grated 8. Pizza Sauce – 1 1/2 cups 9. Garlic – 3 cloves, minced 10. Unsalted Butter – 3 tbsp, melted 11. Italian Seasoning – 2 tsp 12. Dried Oregano – 1 tsp 13. Red Pepper Flakes – 1/2 tsp 14. Salt – 1/2 tsp 15. Black Pepper – 1/2 tsp 16. Fresh Parsley – 2 tbsp, finely chopped 17. Egg – 1 large, beaten 18. Olive Oil – 1 tbsp Recipe 1. Preheat the oven to 400°F and line a large baking sheet with parchment paper. Lightly brush the parchment with the olive oil. 2. In a small bowl, combine the melted butter, minced garlic, Italian seasoning, oregano, red pepper flakes, salt, black pepper, and 1 tablespoon of the fresh parsley. Set the garlic-herb butter aside. 3. Lightly flour a work surface and roll the pizza dough into a large rectangle approximately 12 by 18 inches, keeping the thickness even from edge to edge. 4. Brush a thin layer of the garlic-herb butter over the dough, leaving about a 1-inch border around all sides so the filling stays contained while rolling. 5. Spread 1 cup of pizza sauce over the dough, keeping the sauce inside the border. Sprinkle 1 cup of shredded mozzarella and 1/4 cup of Parmesan evenly over the sauce. 6. Layer the sliced ham, salami, and pepperoni evenly over the cheese. Arrange the meats in overlapping layers so every slice of the finished stromboli contains a generous amount of filling. 7. Add the sliced provolone over the deli meats, then sprinkle the remaining mozzarella and Parmesan over the top. 8. Starting from one long edge, roll the dough tightly over the filling, continuing to roll until you reach the opposite edge. Pinch the seam firmly closed and tuck both ends underneath. 9. Carefully transfer the stromboli seam-side down onto the prepared baking sheet. Brush the entire surface with the beaten egg for a glossy golden crust. 10. Use a sharp knife to cut 5 to 7 shallow diagonal slits across the top of the dough. These vents allow steam to escape while giving the finished stromboli its classic bakery-style appearance. 11.
